result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape` in the CLI. The module compiles offline, but I did not run the jar, so the usage output and the `analyzeLandscape` run are unverified.

**Changes (both in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`):**
- `Commands.java`: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, with the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- `CommandLineInterface.java`: `analyzeLandscape` dispatches to the same `updateLandscape` method. That method now takes the command name and description as parameters, so `-help` prints the name the user typed. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.

**README:** it has no command list (only a Docker `init` line and a pointer to sokrates.dev), so I did not add one. Say if you want a command section added.

**Not verified:** running `java -jar` was blocked by the approval prompt. The cli module has no tests of its own, so nothing was run beyond compilation. Nothing is committed.
